TPM on every SBC cape, secure elements on non-SBC nodes
secure element on non-SBC nodes (Commo Rev
OPTIGA Trust M on ESC + servo controllers
Procedure pending the Rev U re-audit of guide Phases 4-11 (graphical-build-guide/WBS.md 1.5.6).
This card shows the Rev U architecture only; follow the authority documents named below.
Provision every node before first flight.
Pair each OPTIGA Trust M part: the default 0xE140 object is world-readable.
TPM provisioning is non-reversible. Complete every dependent check before provisioning.
